prompt:
Edit paint_mask_guide.png precisely. Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce ONE transparent PNG, 1536x2048 or nearest 3:4 size. Image 1 paint_mask_guide.png is the EDIT TARGET, exact layout and silhouette authority. Image 2 design_reference.png is material/detail reference only. Image 3 icon_x8.png is colour reference only (magenta is background).
The guide has three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows 3-4 hold identical five orthographic model views: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.
Paint grey objects ONLY, preserve exact positions, sizes, outlines, holes and gaps; do not redraw, enlarge, move or redesign geometry. Adapt reference decoration as surface paint within the existing plain band silhouettes, never add projecting bezel or gems.
Rows 1-2 PAINT: unlit base colour of Soulband, silver band with reference blue four-lobed faceted gemstone design and small gold embellishments, reference engravings and inner swirls scaled to each view. Reference ornament appears on appropriate front outward surface only; other views correspond consistently. Soulband wasn't so much created as it was evolved from something else. It started its life as a trinket worn by a small child who became possessed by a Revenant. Since that time it has passed from owner to owner, taking a little piece of them with it when it passed to its new owner. Effects +50 SP; +5 Light, +3 Meditation; of Speed. This is context only, no text.
Rows 3-4 MATERIAL MASK: same five silhouettes and corresponding material locations filled FLAT pure colours ONLY: #FF0000 for ALL metal (silver and gold both pure red); #000000 for ALL gemstone/crystal/glass/pearl/enamel/liquid. Every silhouette pixel exactly one of those colours. No shading, texture, outlines, antialiased colour blends inside. Match painted gem positions exactly.
Transparent background and every opening fully transparent; black gemstone mask is opaque black, not transparency. Empty cells column 3 row 2 and column 3 row 4 stay transparent. No lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights, reflections, glow, sparkles, aura, ground, outlines or text. Preserve the guide canvas composition exactly.
CRITICAL CORRECTION: The previous attempt failed by adding raised bezels that expanded silhouettes and red noise in transparent space. Start again from the ORIGINAL grey guide. Lock its alpha silhouettes. All decoration must be painted flat INSIDE original band surfaces, no geometric additions whatsoever. Lower half must be clean solid binary red/black silhouettes, with absolutely NO lines or shading within red and NO scattered pixels outside rings. Holes must be entirely transparent. Treat this as precise registered texture projection sheet, not a redesigned jewelry rendering. Exact 3:4 canvas.
